summary: TRADEOS v1.1.2 Platform Synchronization & Mobile Parity — full regression PASS. All 16/16 review-request features verified end-to-end at Desktop (1920x1080) and Mobile (390x844) viewports. Backend estimates API is properly wired (routes registered, auth guarded); Supabase 'estimates' and 'estimate_line_items' tables are NOT yet provisioned, so the API returns 500 and the frontend correctly falls back to localStorage (this is the documented expected Phase 2 behavior). Sync status indicator honestly reports 'Local' (desktop) / CloudOff icon (mobile).

minor.issue: Returns 500 because Supabase tables 'estimates' and 'estimate_line_items' do not exist in the schema cache (PGRST205: 'Could not find the table public.estimates'). action_items: PRIORITY-P1 (Phase 3 unlock): Create Supabase tables `public.estimates` and `public.estimate_line_items` with the schema implied by /app/backend/routes/estimates.py (columns: id, organization_id, created_by, name, estimate_number, status, opportunity_id, client_id, description, tax_rate, markup_percent, valid_until, notes, subtotal, markup_amount, tax_amount, total, item_count, created_at, updated_at; line items: id, estimate_id, standard_id, quantity, unit_price, unit_price_override, line_total, notes, sort_order, snapshot jsonb, created_at). Until these exist, all 'sync to cloud' UX degrades to 'saved locally'.

PRIORITY-P2 (contingency_percent + pricing_profile persistence): Backend EstimateCreate/EstimateUpdate models do NOT include contingency_percent or pricing_profile fields — frontend stashes them inside description JSON on save, but loadEstimate reads them as estimate.contingency_percent / estimate.pricing_profile which will be undefined from API. Add these two fields to the Pydantic models and DB schema so loadEstimate hydrates them correctly on cross-device pull.

PRIORITY-P3 (line item extended metadata): Frontend line items store scope, pricing_profile_at_add, and rich snapshot (low_rate/standard_rate/premium_rate/complex_rate/material_price/labor_price). Backend snapshot on add_line_item only captures 6 fields. Align schemas so no data loss on cross-device sync.

PRIORITY-P3 (client_info / project_info): Frontend saves these as top-level fields in localStorage estimate but sends them JSON-encoded inside `description` when posting to backend. loadEstimate reads `estimate.client_info` and `estimate.project_info` directly which won't exist on API response. Suggest adding first-class jsonb columns for client_info / project_info / company_profile_snapshot / clarifications / internal_notes.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: sync_status correctly transitions synced → syncing → offline → synced on save flow (EstimateWorkbench.jsx L410, L498, L526, L589).
GOOD: MobileWorkbench receives full prop parity with Desktop (all 25+ props passed at L858-928).

MINOR: EstimateWorkbench.jsx useEffect at L648 depends on `searchParams` which is a URLSearchParams object — this may cause infinite re-runs on some browsers. Consider destructuring the id first: const id = searchParams.get('id'); useEffect(..., [fetchLibraryData, fetchEstimates, id, loadEstimate]).

MINOR: loadEstimate hydrates contingency_percent, pricing_profile, client_info, project_info, clarifications, internal_notes from API response as top-level fields (L315-343) but backend never returns them (they're stashed inside description JSON). This means cross-device load will lose these fields once Supabase tables exist. Recommend either (a) parse description JSON on load, or (b) add first-class columns.
MINOR: On save, frontend serializes extendedMetadata into description field (L440-450) but on load never de-serializes description JSON — asymmetric write/read.

CONSISTENCY: Company logo path uses two different storage semantics: mobile prefers companyProfileSnapshot?.logo only (L153), desktop falls back to loadCompanyProfile()?.logo (L941-947). If snapshot exists but current profile has newer logo, mobile shows stale logo. Not a bug but worth documenting.
